g.text: Sequence Diagram B: Oxygen Leak Emergency Handling
1. Trigger Emergency, Identify Habitat & Deduct Initial Oxygen Loss
2. Submit Emergency to Colony & Evaluate Responders / Resources
[for each required responder type (Engineer, RepairRobot) & candidate Agent]
Unresolved leak deducts oxygenLoss a second time
All-or-nothing resource rule: no SPARE_PARTS consumed.
Additional oxygenLoss deducted from affected Habitat.
Leak repaired: no second oxygen loss applied.
